title: Networking DNS Resolution Test
summary: Read-only Networking script for dns resolution test.
description: Official OperatorOS ScriptForge seed script that collects dns resolution test data for technician review, reporting, and customer documentation. This script is designed as a read-only audit/reporting baseline.
use_case: Use this script when building a Networking health report, onboarding baseline, recurring audit, or escalation packet.

safety.notes: Official OperatorOS read-only audit/reporting seed script. Review tenant scope and permissions before running.

requirements.name: Windows PowerShell 5.1 or newer with network cmdlets available.

examples.title: Run report
examples.description: Runs the read-only audit report with default options.

output.description: PowerShell object output suitable for pipeline export, transcript capture, or manual review.

script_body:
param(
  [string]$DnsName = 'example.com'
)

$OperatorOSFrameworkPath = Join-Path -Path $PSScriptRoot -ChildPath '..\..\..\framework\OperatorOS-ScriptFramework.psm1'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $OperatorOSFrameworkPath) {
    Import-Module $OperatorOSFrameworkPath -Force
}


# OperatorOS ScriptForge official read-only audit script
# Category: Networking
# Report: DNS Resolution Test

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Resolve-DnsName -Name $DnsName | Select-Object Name,Type,IPAddress,NameHost
